name: Natural cork round coasters, 10 cm, set of 6 (kraft-box gift pack, no holder)
supplier_cost_note: DERIVED from listed per-piece prices, not a quote. WebSearch snippets seen 2026-11-20 (IndiaMART pages not opened; blocked): Enable Nature, Jaipur (Rajasthan) lists 10 cm round cork coasters at Rs 16/piece, so 6 x Rs 16 = Rs 96. Divine Cork India, Vadodara (Gujarat) lists 4 mm round cork coasters at Rs 25/piece (6 x 25 = Rs 150). Other listings: round cork tea coaster Rs 35/piece (Dharmi Kreation); 4-piece cork coaster set with holder Rs 119; cork coaster set 4 in Rs 60/set (m.indiamart.com/impcat/cork-coasters.html). MOQ, thickness, GST treatment (incl./excl.), kraft box and single-order drop-ship were not visible. At Rs 150 (Vadodara price) cost is about 33% of price, above the ~29% out-of-state limit, so the Rs 16 Jaipur price (or an equivalent) must be confirmed in writing, including box and packing.
retail_observed: Seen 2026-11-20 via WebSearch snippets (pages not opened): IKEA round reversible cork coaster set, 3 pieces, on Flipkart Rs 380 (list Rs 699) on one listing and Rs 489 on another (flipkart.com/ikea-round-reversible-cork-coaster-set/p/itm0ed5e0932383f); IKEA India's own site IKEA 365 cork coaster Rs 92 per 2-pack (ikea.com/in/en/p/ikea-365-coaster-cork-10282947); UMAI set of 6 (diatomite, not cork) with cork-and-steel holder Rs 1,059 on Globalbees. Flipkart 6-piece WOOD (not cork) coaster sets with holder Rs 133-150 (Craftzo, LADECOR). No Amazon.in or Meesho price for a natural cork 6-set found. Rs 449 for 6 cork coasters (about Rs 75 each) is below the Flipkart IKEA reseller price per piece but well above IKEA's own Rs 46 each; the mass-marketplace price for a 6-set is UNVALIDATED.

demand_signals.source: Flipkart listing of IKEA cork coaster 3-set (resold)
demand_signals.summary: Natural cork coasters are listed on Flipkart at Rs 380-489 for 3 pieces (cached snippets). Shows price acceptance for cork coasters on a mass marketplace; no sales volume or trend data found.
IKEA sells a 10 cm cork coaster at Rs 92 per 2-pack. Shows that the category exists in India, but it also sets a low price anchor (competition risk).

demand_signals.source: Globalbees UMAI coaster set of 6 with cork holder
demand_signals.summary: A D2C 6-piece coaster set with a cork holder sells at Rs 1,059, so a premium coaster-set tier exists. It is a different material (diatomite) and gives a price-band signal only.

risks: Competition: IKEA's own price is Rs 46 per cork coaster and Flipkart wood 6-sets with holder are Rs 133-150, so Rs 449 depends on gift-pack presentation. Check live Amazon.in and Meesho cork 6-set prices before asking for a quote

Supplier cost is derived (6 x Rs 16 listed price) and not quoted. Box, packing and GST are not included. Out-of-state supplier (Rajasthan) means website-only via bill-to-ship-to (docs/05), so cost must stay at about Rs 130 or less (~29% of Rs 449). The Vadodara Rs 25/piece price would fail this
Close to already-explored coaster lines (resin gold-foil coasters, sabai grass coaster set 6); reviewer to check it is not a repeat of a failed line
Thin 3-4 mm cork can crumble or chip at the edges and stains with use, which can drive 'not as pictured' returns. Specify 5 mm+ thickness and photograph the real stock
'Natural cork' is a material claim; agglomerated cork is common. Get supplier evidence (policy require_evidence_for_claims)
No demand trend data found (Google Trends not checked this run); demand is inferred from listings only
GST: natural cork articles (HSN 4503) assumed 5% after the 22-09-2025 rate changes (previously 12%); CA to confirm

review.notes: Rs 449 is not a realistic price: comparable cork 6-sets sit at about Rs 276-297 (IKEA's own 10 cm cork coaster Rs 92 per 2-pack = Rs 276 for 6; Birch & Co. cork set of 6 Rs 297 on a price tracker, ASIN B0CJ96PC8K), wood 6-sets sell at Rs 136-148 on Meesho and Rs 146 on Flipkart, and the only Flipkart cork 6-set found is a mixed leather/wood/cork set at Rs 519. Cutting to a competitive ~Rs 299 puts it below the policy floor of Rs 449 (min_price_inr), and holding Rs 449 with no holder repeats the failure of the rejected sabai grass coaster set of 6 (RA-20261022B-2). Rs 16/piece is only a listing price (no MOQ, GST, box or packing cost), so it does not rescue the case.

review.supplier_cost_check: Confirmed via WebSearch 2026-11-20 that IndiaMART's cork-coasters category (https://m.indiamart.com/impcat/cork-coasters.html) shows 'Enable Nature Cork Coasters, 10 cm, Round' at Rs 16/piece, seller Jaipur. MOQ, thickness, GST and stock are not shown, the product page was not opened, and no kraft-box or packing cost was found. Rs 96 + box/packing stays under ~Rs 130 only if box and packing cost <= ~Rs 34 (unverified). The Vadodara Rs 25/piece alternative (Rs 150) fails the ~29% out-of-state guide on its own.
review.repeat_check: The sabai grass coaster set of 6 (RA-20261022B-2, Rs 499, no holder) was rejected on 2026-10-22 because no-holder 6-sets had no edge over cheaper sets that include a holder. This cork set is the same idea (no-holder 6-set near the price floor) in a cheaper, more commoditised material. The resin gold-foil coaster set (RA-20261113D-1) is needs_info for lack of price headroom.
review.unverified: No live Amazon.in or Meesho natural-cork 6-set price found in 4 searches. The Rs 250 undercut threshold is not confirmed to be breached, but nearby cork sets are Rs 276-297 and wood substitutes are Rs 136-148.
review.complaint_patterns: Reviews of similar cork coasters on non-Indian sites, seen 2026-11-20: crumbling under heat or moisture (https://www.wayfair.ca/dining/pdp/betus-round-cork-coasters-set-set-of-16-btsa1058.html), 'too thin' (https://hobbylobby.com/crafts-hobbies/wood-crafts-blank-surfaces/cork-boards/round-cork-coasters---4/p/28807), staining (https://www.fakespot.com/product/yhy-absorbent-stone-coaster-set-drink-spills-coasters-set-of-6-grey-line-geometric-pattern), and 'cork look' sets that are actually MDF (https://www.kmart.co.nz/product/set-of-6-natural-cork-look-coasters-42535331/). This supports the researcher's thin-cork return risk.
